programs.title: Killer In My Home
programs.desc: (2020) Sinister thriller starring Bree Williamson. Allison's world falls apart when her husband dies suddenly. But then his secret family turn up, who have everything but good intentions...

programs.title: Bandidas
programs.desc: A poor farm girl and the daughter of a wealthy landowner have to team up to get revenge on baron who is trying to take their land. Starring Penelope Cruz and Selma Hayek (2006).

programs.title: Black Water
programs.desc: When he is imprisoned aboard a CIA submarine under mysterious circumstances, a deep cover operative joins forces with another prisoner to break free. Stars Jean-Claude Van Damme, Dolph Lundgren (2018)

programs.title: Triple Cross
programs.desc: (1967) WWII spy thriller with Christopher Plummer. Loosely based on a true story, bank robber Eddie Chapman gets entangled in spying for both sides during World War Two, becoming a triple agent.

programs.title: Predestination
programs.desc: (2015) Sci-fi action with Ethan Hawke and Succession's Sarah Snook. A temporal agent who stops crimes before they happen is tasked with catching a fugitive who's always one step ahead in time.

programs.title: Kentucky Rifle
programs.desc: (1955) Suspenseful western with Chill Wills, Lance Fuller and Cathy Downs. When a gun-filled wagon breaks down in enemy territory, will its occupants surrender their cargo or fight for their lives?
